data.body: INVESTIGATION: Confirmed 9 test files with ~39 grep/awk-against-MERGE_SCRIPT patterns. Per the ticket, remediation requires either deleting redundant tests or rewriting each grep assertion as an execution-based test that invokes the script and asserts observable outputs. This is a multi-session effort — each rewrite needs RED/GREEN cycle for each behavioral assertion. Recommend prioritizing the ~21 patterns in test-merge-to-main.sh first (highest concentration). Leave open as follow-up for a dedicated session.
